---
name: Jenkins proxy context aliases
description: URL rewriting must recognize both the Jenkins context and the app's UI mount alias.
---

The embedded Jenkins proxy can receive or generate both `/jenkins/...` and `/ui/jenkins/...` references. The latter is already associated with the app's UI mount and must be normalized directly to the single proxy context; treating it as a generic root-relative URL creates duplicated paths and upstream 404s.

**Why:** Jenkins dynamic requests such as resource bundles and descriptor renders are generated by JavaScript after the initial page loads, so a homepage can work while configuration controls fail.

**How to apply:** Keep `/ui/jenkins` ahead of generic root-relative rewriting and exclude it from generic path-prefix rules. Validate dynamic GET and POST URLs, not only the initial iframe document.
